software-development: Build or change software: tests-first, stack patterns (Python/Go/Rust/React…), APIs, databases, containers.
data-analysis: Work with data and judge AI output: SQL, stats, charts, and evals.
rag-evaluation: Measure a RAG or retrieval system. Scores search and answers separately.
product-management: Plan product work: PRDs, roadmaps, prioritization, and go-to-market.
application-security: Find and fix app vulnerabilities, and write secure code.
frontend-design: Build and polish web interfaces: layout, accessibility, motion, design systems.
web-research: Research a topic online and synthesize a cited answer.
release-review: Final gate before shipping: review, verify, confirm it's ready.
bug-fixing: Find and fix a specific bug fast. Root-cause debugging, no ceremony.
code-simplification: Cut over-engineering. Find and delete what you don't need.
content-writing: Write and edit prose: copy, articles, docs, and UX text.
production-engineering: Ship production-grade systems: architecture, security, compliance, deploy, and operate.
test-engineering: Test software end to end: strategy, unit, e2e, regression, and quality gates.
sample-rag-evals: Sample custom kit. A small, focused kit for checking a RAG agent's answers. Edit it, delete it, or copy it as a starting point for your own.
sample-content-writing: Sample custom kit. A small kit for writing and cleaning up docs. Edit it, delete it, or copy it as a starting point for your own.
